First, I need to calculate how much more money Paolo needs to buy the console. Since the console costs 390 euros and he already has 120 euros, we subtract the amount he has from the total cost:

390 euros (cost of console) - 120 euros (already saved) = 270 euros (still needed).

Now, Paolo saves 15 euros each week. To find out how many weeks he needs to save 270 euros, we divide the amount still needed by the weekly savings:

270 euros / 15 euros per week = 18 weeks.

Therefore, Paolo will need 18 weeks of saving 15 euros each week to have enough money to buy the console.
